def subtract<w>(a, b):
    x = bits(a, w)
    y = bits(b, w)
    result = [0] * (w + 1)
    borrow = 0
    for i in range(w):
        parity = x[i] ^ y[i]
        result[i] = parity ^ borrow
        borrow = ((1 ^ x[i]) & y[i]) | ((1 ^ parity) & borrow)
    result[w] = borrow
    return pack(result)

w = p if p >= q else q
difference = bits(subtract<w>(a, b), w + 1)
return pack(difference[:w]), difference[w]
